system.description:
You release a surge of chakra throughout your body, activating your bodies adrenaline production and kicking it into high gear for single swift moment while also increasing your bodies sensitivity to pain.

The next Taijutsu you cast, that requires an attack roll gains a +2 bonus to its critical threat range.

Additionally, until the beginning of your next turn, the next instance of damage you take increases by +5.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage you receive by +5. If this jutsu is cast a C-Rank or higher, you reroll 1’s and 2’s rolled for damage dice taking the second result. If this jutsu is Cast at B-Rank or higher, if you score a critical hit, you add 2d12 to the damage dealt.

If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, the next Taijutsu you cast that requires an attack roll ignores resistance & immunity.

If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you gain +1 additional Action this turn.
